primary_diagnosis_treated: Cardiorenal volume‑overload syndrome (chronic heart failure with end‑stage renal disease)
nice_guideline_used: NICE NG106 (Chronic heart failure) and NICE NG203 (Chronic kidney disease)

medications.purpose: Blood pressure control and adjunct volume management in CKD/HF
medications.nice_justification: NG106 recommends thiazide‑type diuretic for hypertension in HF; NG203 recommends ACE‑I/ARB but thiazide is acceptable for BP control

medications.medication: Acetaminophen 300 mg / Hydrocodone Bitartrate 5 mg oral tablet
medications.dose: One tablet as needed for pain
medications.duration: As needed – review pain control every 3 months
medications.purpose: Management of chronic low‑back pain and osteoarthritis
medications.nice_justification: Analgesia not contraindicated in HF or CKD (NG106, NG203)

medications.dose: 2.5 mg once daily (start), titrate to 10 mg once daily as tolerated
medications.duration: Lifelong – titrate over 4‑6 weeks, then review annually
medications.purpose: Disease‑modifying therapy for HFrEF and renoprotective agent for proteinuric CKD
medications.nice_justification: NG106 first‑line ACE‑I for HFrEF; NG203 ACE‑I for CKD with proteinuria

medications.dose: 1.25 mg once daily (start), double dose every 2 weeks to target ≤10 mg once daily
medications.duration: Lifelong – titrate over 6‑8 weeks, then review annually
medications.purpose: Reduce mortality and improve symptoms in HFrEF

medications.duration: Lifelong – monitor K⁺/creatinine after 2 weeks then every 6 months
medications.purpose: MRA for HFrEF to reduce mortality and hospitalisation
medications.nice_justification: NG106 MRA recommended for all HFrEF patients

medications.dose: 20 mg once daily (adjust to achieve euvolemia)
medications.duration: As needed for congestion; once stable, maintain lowest effective dose – review weekly until euvolemic then every 3 months
medications.purpose: Relieve volume overload (edema, dyspnoea) in HF
medications.nice_justification: NG106 loop diuretic for symptomatic fluid overload

medications.purpose: Cardiovascular risk reduction in CKD and ischemic heart disease
medications.nice_justification: NG203 statin for all CKD patients as CV risk equivalent

medications.dose: 10 mg once daily (initiate only if eGFR ≥ 20 mL/min/1.73 m²)
medications.duration: Lifelong – renal function review 2 weeks after start then every 6 months
medications.purpose: Reduce HF hospitalisation and slow CKD progression
medications.nice_justification: NG106 SGLT2‑i for HFrEF (TA902/TA929); NG203 SGLT2‑i for CKD with eGFR 20‑45

interactions_checked.interaction: Potential offset of potassium effects (ACE‑I may raise K⁺, HCTZ may lower K⁺) but overall risk of hyperkalaemia remains; monitor serum K⁺.
interactions_checked.action: Check K⁺ and creatinine 1‑2 weeks after initiation and after each dose change.

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive risk of hyperkalaemia and renal function decline.
interactions_checked.action: Monitor K⁺ and eGFR 1‑2 weeks after start and after any dose adjustment.

interactions_checked.interaction: Synergistic diuretic effect may cause volume depletion, hyponatraemia, or electrolyte disturbances.
interactions_checked.action: Assess volume status, weight, electrolytes weekly until stable.

interactions_checked.interaction: Combined osmotic and loop diuresis can increase risk of dehydration and hypotension.
interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure, weight, and renal function after initiation.

contraindications.reason: Contraindicated in both HF and CKD due to fluid retention and renal impairment (NG106, NG203).
contraindications.alternative: Paracetamide (acetaminophen) for pain as already prescribed.

contraindications.reason: Can cause fluid retention and worsen HF (NG106).
Risk of lactic acidosis in ESRD (NG203).
contraindications.alternative: Consider dose reduction only if eGFR ≥ 30; otherwise avoid.

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ESRD but exact value unknown; dapagliflozin to be started only if eGFR ≥ 20 mL/min/1.73 m².
Serum potassium not provided – assumed ≤5.0 mmol/L; baseline K⁺ required before ACE‑I/MRA.
Left ventricular ejection fraction not provided – assumed HFrEF (LVEF ≤ 40 %) based on NT‑proBNP and volume overload; echocardiogram required before full beta‑blocker titration.
Liver function tests not provided – assumed normal; baseline ALT/AST required before statin.
Allergy status not documented – verify no ACE‑I or statin allergy before prescribing.
treatment_summary: The plan combines guideline‑directed heart‑failure therapy (ACE‑I, beta‑blocker, MRA, loop diuretic, SGLT2‑i) with CKD‑focused measures (ACE‑I, statin, careful diuretic use) while continuing existing antihypertensive (hydrochlorothiazide) and analgesia. All new agents are first‑line per NICE NG106 and NG203, doses are started low for this elderly, frail, ESRD patient, and monitoring of renal function, electrolytes, blood pressure, and volume status is built in. Contraindicated drugs (NSAIDs, thiazolidinediones, verapamil/diltiazem, metformin in severe renal impairment) are avoided. Pending investigations (eGFR, K⁺, LVEF, LFTs) are required before finalising titration.
